Tietoja: Siri ja yksityisyys (maeOS) 
Kun käytät Siriä, kaikki sanomasi tallennetaan ja lähetetään Applelle pyyntöjesi käsittelyä 
varten. Laite lähettää Applelle myös muita tietoja, kuten nimesi, lempinimesi, osoitekirjasi 
yhteystietojen nimet, lempinimet ja yhteystiedoista löydetyt suhteet (esim. isä), 
musiikkikokoelmasi kappaleiden nimet, kuva-albumiesi nimet sekä laitteellesi asennettujen 
ohjelmien nimet, yhteisnimeltä "käyttäjän tiedot". Näiden tietojen avulla Siri oppii 
ymmärtämään sinua ja tunnistamaan sanomasi paremmin. Näitä tietoja ei linkitetä muihin 
tietoihin, joita Applella saattaa olla muiden Apple-palvelujen käytöstäsi. Kun käytät Siriä 
etsimään dokumenttejasi, Siri-pyyntö lähetetään Applelle, mutta dokumenttiesi nimiä tai sisältöä 
ei lähetetä. Etsintä suoritetaan paikallisesti Macilla. 
Jos Sijaintipalvelut ovat käytössä, lähetetään myös laitteesi pyynnönaikainen sijainti Applelle. 
Tämä auttaa Siriä parantamaan pyyntöjesi vastausten tarkkuutta. Voit myös laittaa 
Sijaintipalvelut pois päältä Siriltä. Tee tämä avaamalla Järjestelmäasetukset Macissa, 
klikkaamalla Suojaus ja yksityisyys, klikkaamalla Sijaintipalvelut ja poistamalla Sirin 
valintaneliön valinta. 
Voit laittaa Sirin pois päältä milloin tahansa. Laita Siri pois päältä avaamalla 
Järjestelmäasetukset Macissa, valitsemalla Siri ja poistamalla Ota Siri käyttöön -valintaneliön 
valinta. Jos laitat sekä Sirin että sanelun pois päältä, Apple poistaa käyttäjän tiedot sekä 
viimeisimmän puhesyötedatan. Vanhempi puhesyötedata, joka ei yksilöi sinua 
henkilökohtaisesti, voidaan säilyttää jonkin aikaa. Sen avulla parannetaan yleisesti Siriä, sanelua 
sekä sanelutoimintoa muissa Applen tuotteissa ja palveluissa. Tämä puhesyötedata voi sisältää 
äänitiedostoja ja puhtaaksikirjoitettua tekstiä puhutuista pyynnöistä ja niihin liittyviä 
vianmääritystietoja, kuten tietoja laitteistosta ja käyttöjärjestelmästä, suorituskykytilastoja sekä 
laitteesi arvioitu pyynnönaikainen sijainti. 
Voit myös estää Sirin käytön kokonaan Käyttörajoitukset-asetuksissa. 
Kun käytät Siriä, hyväksyt ja annat luvan Applelle ja sen tytäryhtiöille ja edustajille siirtää, 
kerätä, ylläpitää, käsitellä ja käyttää näitä tietoja, mukaan lukien puhesyötettä ja käyttäjän tietoja, 
Sirin ja sanelutoiminnon tuottamiseen ja parantamiseen muissa Applen tuotteissa ja palveluissa. 
Applen keräämiä tietoja käsitellään noudattaen Applen yksityisyydensuojakäytäntöä, joka löytyy 
osoitteesta www.apple.com/Wprivacy. 
EFTA00289205

À propos de Siri et de la confidentialité (macOS) 
Lorsque vous utilisez Siri, ce que vous dites est enregistré et envoyé à Apple afin de traiter vos 
requêtes. Votre appareil enverra aussi à Apple d'autres informations, telles que votre prénom et 
surnom ; les noms, surnoms et relations (par exemple « mon père ») provenant de vos contacts ; 
les noms des morceaux de votre collection, les titres de vos albums photo et le nom des apps 
installées sur votre appareil (l'ensemble constituant vos « Données utilisateur »). Toutes ces 
données sont utilisées pour permettre à Ski de mieux vous comprendre et de reconnaître ce que 
vous dites. Elles ne sont liées à aucune autre donnée qu'Apple pourrait avoir obtenue par votre 
utilisation d'autres services Apple. Lorsque vous utilisez Siri pour rechercher des documents, la 
requête Siri est envoyée à Apple mais pas le titre et le contenu de ces documents. La recherche 
est effectuée localement, sur le Mac. 
Si vous avez activé le service de localisation, la position géographique de votre appareil au 
moment où vous énoncez une requête sera également envoyée à Apple, pour permettre à Siri 
d'améliorer la précision de sa réponse à vos questions. Vous pouvez choisir de désactiver le 
service de localisation pour Siri. Pour ce faire, ouvrez Préférences Système sur votre Mac, 
cliquez sur Sécurité et confidentialité, sélectionnez le service de localisation puis décochez la 
case pour Siri. 
Vous pouvez choisir à tout moment de désactiver Siri. Pour désactiver Siri, ouvrez Préférences 
Système sur votre Mac, cliquez sur Siri et décochez la case Activer Siri. Si vous désactivez Siri 
et la fonctionnalité Dictée, Apple effacera vos données utilisateur ainsi que vos données de saisie 
vocale récentes. Les anciennes données de saisie vocale ayant été dissociées de vous pourront 
être conservées pendant un certain temps afin d'améliorer de manière générale Siri, Dictée et la 
fonction de dictée d'autres produits et services Apple. Ces données de saisie vocale peuvent 
comporter des fichiers audio et des transcriptions de ce que vous avez dit, ainsi que des données 
de diagnostic associées, telles que des spécifications de matériel et de système d'exploitation, des 
statistiques de performances et la position approximative de votre appareil au moment de la 
requête. 
Vous pouvez également limiter la possibilité d'utiliser Siri dans le réglage du contrôle parental. 
En utilisant Siri, vous acceptez qu'Apple, ainsi que ses filiales et ses représentants, transmettent, 
recueillent, conservent, traitent et utilisent ces données, notamment votre voix et vos données 
utilisateur, pour offrir et améliorer Siri, Dictée et la fonction de dictée d'autres produits et 
services Apple. 
Les informations recueillies par Apple sont traitées en tout temps conformément à l'engagement 
de confidentialité d'Apple, consultable à l'adresse : www.apple.com/fr/privacy. 
EFTA00289206

Sid i privatnosti (macOS) 
Kad koristite Siri, stvari koje izgovorite če se snimiti i poslati tvrtki Apple radi obrade vaših 
zahtjeva. Vaš uredaj če tvrtki Apple takoder poslati druge informacije, kao što su vaše ime i 
nadimak; imena, nadimci i vaši odnosi (primjerice, "moj tata") pronadeni u vašim kontaktima, 
nazive pjesama u vašoj kolekciji, imena vaših fotoalbuma i nazive aplikacija instaliranih na 
vašim uredajima (zajedno, vaši "korisnički podaci"). Svi ovi podaci pomažu aplikaciji Siri i 
značajki diktata kako bi vas bolje razumjeli i prepoznali što govorite. Ti podaci nisu povezani s 
ostalim podacima koje je tvrtka Apple možda prikupila tijekom vaše uporabe drugih usluga 
tvrtke Apple. Kad koristite Siri za traženje vaših dokumenata, Appleu se šalje zahtjev aplikacije 
Siri, ali se Appleu ne šalju nazivi i sadržaj vaših dokumenata. Pretraživanje se izvodi lokalno na 
Macu. 
Ako ste uključili lokacijske usluge, lokacija vašeg uredaja u trenutku u kojem podnesete zahtjev 
takoder če se poslati tvrtki Apple kako bi se pomoglo aplikaciji Siri da poboljša točnost svog 
odgovora na vaše zahtjeve. Možete isključiti lokacijske usluge za Siri. Da biste to učinili, 
otvorite Postavke sustava na svom Macu, kliknite Sigumost i privatnost, kliknite Lokacijske 
usluge i odznačite kučicu za Siri. 
Možete isključiti Siri u bilo kojem trenutku. Za isključenje Siri, otvorite Postavke sustava na 
svom Macu, odaberite Siri i odznačite kučicu za Aktiviraj Siri. (sključite li i Siri i Diktat, Apple 
če obrisati vaše korisničke podatke kao i novije glasovne unose. Stariji podaci glasovnih unosa, 
koji nisu povezani s vama, mogu se zadržati odredeni period za opčenito poboljšanje Siri, 
Diktata i funkcije diktata u drugim Apple proizvodima i uslugama. Takvi podaci glasovnog 
unosa mogu sadržavati audio datoteke i transkripte onog što ste rekli i povezane dijagnostičke 
podatke, primjerice, specifikacije hardvera i operativnog sustava, statistiku učinkovitosti te 
priblibm lokaciju vašeg uredaja u vrijeme zahtjeva. 
Takoder možete u potpunosti blokirati mogučnost uporabe aplikacije Siri u Postavkama 
roditeljskih kontrola. 
Uporabom mačajki Siri, slažete se da Apple i njegove podružnice te agenti smiju odašiljati, 
prikupljati, održavati, obradivati i koristiti te informacije, uključujuči vaš glasovni unos i 
korisničke podatke kako bi pružili i poboljšali Siri i funkcionalnost diktiranja u drugim 
Appleovim proizvodima i uslugama. 
Informacije koje prikupi Apple če se u svakom trenutku tretirati u skladu s Appleovim pravilima 
privatnosti, koja možete pronači na www.apple.com/hr/privacy.

A Siri és az adatvédelem ismertetése (macOS) 
Amikor a Sirit használja, az eszköz rögzíti a kimondott dolgokat, és elküldi az Apple-nek a 
kérelmek feldolgozásához. Az eszköze más információkat is küld az Apple-nek, például az ön 
nevét és becenevét; a kontaktok neveit, beceneveit és azok önnel való kapcsolatát (pl. „apa"); a 
gyűjteményében található dalcímeket; a fotóalbumai nevét; és az eszközén telepített 
alkalmaAqok neveit (ezek együttesen a „Felhasználói adatok"). Az összes ilyen adat ahhoz lesz 
felhasználva, hogy a Siri jobban megértse önt, és felismerje, mit mond. A kapott adatok nem 
kapcsolódnak össze a többi Apple-szolgáltatás használatából származó adatokkal. Amikor a Sirit 
használja dokumentumok kereséséhez, a Siri-kérés el lesz küldve az Apple-nek, de a 
dokumentumainak neve és tartalma nem lesz elküldve az Apple-nek. A keresés helyben, a Mac 
gépén történik. 
Ha a Helymeghatározás be van kapcsolva, az eszköz helye (a kérés elküldésének időpontjában) 
szintén el lesz küldve az Apple részére, hogy a Siri javítsa a válaszai pontosságát. A Siri számára 
kikapcsolhatja a Helymeghatározást. Ehhez nyissa meg a Rendszerbeállításokat a Mac gépén, 
kattintson a Biztonság és adatvédelem lehetőségre, kattintson a Helymeghatározás lehetőségre, 
és törölje a Siri négyzet bejelölését. 
A Sirit bármikor kikapcsolhatja. A Siri kikapcsolásához nyissa meg a Rendszerbeállításokat a 
Mac gépén, válassza a Siri lehetőséget, és törölje a Siri engedélyezése négyzet bejelölését. Ha 
kikapcsolja a Sirit és a Diktálást is, az Apple törli a Felhasználói adatokat, valamint a legutóbbi 
hangbeviteli adatokat. A régebbi hangbeviteli adatok, amelyek már nincsenek Önhöz rendelve, 
megmaradhatnak egy ideig a Siri, a Diktálás és egyéb Apple-termékek és -szolgáltatások 
diktálási funkcióinak általános javítása érdekében. Ezek a hangbeviteli adatok tartalmazhatnak 
hangfájlokat és az elmondottak leírt változatát, valamint kapcsolódó diagnosztikai adatokat, 
például a hardver és az operációs rendszer specifikációit és teljesítménystatisztikáit, ezenkívül az 
eszköz hozzávetőleges helyét a kérés elküldése idején. 
A Szülői felügyelet beállításaiban szintén korlátozhatja a Siri használatát. 
A Siri használatával Ön elfogadja és hozzájárul ahhoz, hogy az Apple és leányvállalatai, 
valamint partnerei továbbítsák, begyűjtsék, karbantartsák, feldolgozzák és felhasználják az Ön 
ilyen jellegű információit, például a hangját és a Felhasználói adatait annak érdekében, hogy 
biztosítani és fejleszteni tudják a Sirit és a diktálási funkciókat az Apple termékeiben és 
szolgáltatásaiban. 
Az Apple által gyűjtött információk mindig az Apple adatvédelmi irányelve szerint lesznek 
felhasználva, amely megtalálható a www.apple.corn/hu/privacy weboldalon.

Nlengenai Siri dan Privasi (maeOS) 
Saat Anda menggunakan Siri, hal yang Anda ucapkan akan direkam dan dikirim ke 
Apple untuk memproses permintaan Anda. Perangkat Anda juga akan mengirim 
informasi lainnya ke Apple, seperti nama dan nama panggilan Anda; nama, nama 
panggilan, dan hubungan (misal, "ayah saya") di kontak Anda, nama lagu dalam koleksi 
Anda, nama album foto Anda, dan nama opp yang terinstal di perangkat Anda (secara 
kolektif, "Data Pengguna" Anda). Semua data ini digunakan untuk membantu Siri lebih 
memahami dan mengenali ucapan Anda. Ini tidak terkait dengan data lainnya yang 
mungkin diperoleh Apple dari penggunaan layanan Apple lainnya. Saat Anda 
menggunakan Siri untuk mencari dokumen Anda, permintaan Siri dikirim ke Apple, 
tetapi nama dan konten dokumen Anda tidak dikirim ke Apple. Pencarian di Mac 
dilakukan secara lokal. 
Jika Layanan Lokasi dinyalakan, lokasi perangkat pada saat Anda membuat permintaan 
juga akan dikirim ke Apple untuk membantu Siri meningkatkan akurasi responsnya 
terhadap permintaan Anda. Anda dapat memilih untuk mematikan Layanan Lokasi 
untuk Siri. Untuk melakukannya, buka Preferensi Sistem di Mac Anda, klik Keamanan & 
Privasi, klik Layanan Lokasi, batal pilih kotak centang untuk Siri. 
Anda dapat memilih untuk mematikan Siri kapan pun. Untuk mematikan Siri, buka 
Preferensi Sistem di Mac Anda, pilih Siri, dan batal pilih kotak centang untuk Aktifkan 
Siri. Jika Anda mematikan fitur Siri dan Dikte, Apple akan menghapus Data Pengguna 
serta data input suara terbaru Anda. Data input suara lama yang dipisahkan dari Anda 
mungkin disimpan selama waktu tertentu untuk meningkatkan Siri, Dikte, dan fungsi 
dikte di produk serta layanan Apple lainnya secara umum Data input suara ini dapat 
berisi file audio dan transkrip ucapan Anda, data diagnostik terkait, seperti spesifikasi 
dan statistik kinerja perangkat keras dan sistem operasi, serta perkiraan lokasi 
perangkat Anda saat permintaan dibuat. 
Anda juga dapat membatasi kemampuan untuk menggunakan Siri secara keseluruhan 
di bawah Pengaturan Pengawasan Orang Tua. 
Dengan menggunakan Siri, Anda menyetujui dan menyepakati pengiriman, 
pengumpulan, pemeliharaan, pemrosesan, dan penggunaan informasi ini, termasuk 
input suara dan Data Pengguna Anda, oleh Apple dan anak perusahaan serta agennya 
untuk menyediakan dan meningkatkan Siri dan fungsi dikte di produk dan layanan 
Apple lainnya. 
Informasi yang dikumpulkan oleh Apple akan diperlakukan sesuai dengan Kebijakan 
Privasi Apple setiap saat, yang dapat ditemukan di www.apple.com/id/privacy.

Informazioni su Sid e sulla privacy (macOS) 
Quando utilizzi Siri, ciò che dici verrà registrato e inviato ad Apple per l'elaborazione delle tue 
richieste. Il tuo dispositivo invierà a Apple anche altre informazioni, quali: il tuo nome e il tuo 
soprannome; i nomi, i soprannomi dei contatti presenti nella tua rubrica e la relazione che hanno 
con te (per es.: "papà"); i nomi dei brani delle tue raccolte, i nomi dei tuoi album fotografici; i 
nomi delle app installate sul dispositivo. Tutti questi dati, definiti collettivamente "dati utente", 
vengono utilizzati per aiutare Siri a capirti meglio e a riconoscere ciò che dici. Tali dati non sono 
collegati ad altri dati che Apple potrebbe aver raccolto in seguito al tuo utilizzo di altri servizi 
Apple. Quando utilizzi Siri per cercare documenti, la richiesta di Siri è inviata a Apple, ma non i 
nomi e i contenuti dei documenti. La ricerca viene effettuata localmente sul Mac. 
Se hai attivato i servizi di localizzazione, verrà inviata a Apple anche la posizione del tuo 
dispositivo quando effettui una richiesta per consentire a Siri di migliorare la precisione delle 
risposte. Puoi scegliere di disattivare i servizi di localizzazione per Siri. Per farlo, apri Preferenze 
di Sistema sul Mac, fai clic su Sicurezza e Privacy, fai clic su "Servizi di localizzazione" e 
deseleziona l'opzione per Siri. 
Puoi scegliere di disattivare Siri in qualsiasi momento. Per disattivare Siri, apri Preferenze di 
Sistema sul Mac, seleziona Siri e deseleziona l'opzione "Abilita Siri" Disattivando Siri e 
Dettatura, Apple eliminerà i dati utente e i dati di input vocale recenti. I dati di input vocale 
meno recenti, che sono stati dissociati da te, potrebbero essere conservati per un periodo di 
tempo al fine di migliorare complessivamente Siri, Dettatura e la funzionalità di dettatura di altri 
prodotti e servizi di Apple. Questi dati di input vocale possono includere i file audio, le 
trascrizioni delle parole pronunciate e i relativi dati di diagnosi, come le specifiche hardware e 
del sistema operativo, le statistiche relative alle prestazioni e la posizione approssimativa del tuo 
dispositivo nel momento in cui effettui una richiesta. 
Inoltre, puoi limitare totalmente la capacità di utilizzo di Siri nelle impostazioni di Controlli 
Parentali. 
Utilizzando Siri, accetti e consenti la trasmissione, la raccolta, la conservazione, l'elaborazione e 
l'utilizzo di tali informazioni (input vocale e dati utente inclusi) da parte di Apple e dei suoi 
partner e licenziatari al fine di migliorare e fornire funzionalità quali Siri e Dettatura in altri 
prodotti e servizi Apple. 
In qualsiasi momento, le informazioni raccolte da Apple saranno trattate in conformità alle 
norme sulla privacy di Apple. Possono essere consultate sul sito www.apple.com/itJprivacy.

いて“Sin "を選択し、“SInを有効にする“チェックボックスの選択を解除します°SInと音

が削除されます°ユーザとの関連付けがすでに解除された古い音声入力データは、Apple

イスのおおよその位置が含まれることがあります°

罰ri 빛 개인 정보 보호에1 판하여（macOS) 
Sin를 사용하는 경우 사용자가 말한 내용온 사용자의 요청을 처리하기 위해1 저장되 
어 Apple로 전송됩니다． 또한 사용자의 기기는 이름， 별명， 연락처에서 찾온 사람과 
사용자와의 관계（예： ' 아빠 ' ) 및 사용자의 모음에 있는 노래1 제목） 사진 앨범의 이름 
및 사용자의 기기에 설치된 앱의 이름（총칭하여 ' 사용자 데이터 ' ）도 Apple어］ 전송됩 
니다 . 수집된 모든 데이터는 Sin가 사용자를 더 잘 이해하도록 돕고 사용자가 하는 
말을 알아듣도록 하는 더］ 사용됩니다． 이 데이터는 Apple이 다른 Apple 서비스에서 
수집한 다른 정보와 관련되지 않습니다 . Sin를 사용하여 도큐멘트를 검색하는 경우 
Sin의 요청만 Apple로 전송됩니다． 도큐멘트 검색온 이 Mac에서 로켤로 수행됩니다． 
위치 서비스가 켜져 있는 경우 사용자가 요청을 보냈을 때 기기 위치 또한 Apple로 
보내지며 Sini가 요청에 대한 응답의 정확성을 향상시키는 더1 사용됩니다 . Sin의 위치 
서비스를 끌 수도 있습니다 . 위치 서비스를 끄려면 M配에서 시스템 환경설정을 열 
고 보안 및 개인 정보 보호를 클릭한 후 위치 서비스를 클릭한 다음 Sin 및 받아쓰 
기 쳬크상자를 선택 해제하십시오． 
Sin는 언제든지 끌 수 있습니다 . Sin를 끄려면 Mac에서 시스템 환경설정을 열고 Sin 
를 클릭한 다음 Sin 활성화 쳬크상자를 선택 해제하십시오 . Sini 및 받아쓰기 기능을 
모두 끄면 Apple에서 사용자 데이터뿐만 아니라 사용자가 최근에 입력한 음성 데이 
터도 삭제됩니다 . 사용자와 관련이 없어진 이전 음성 입력 데이터는 일반적으로 Sin, 
받아쓰기 및 기타 Apple 제품 및 서비스의 받아쓰기 기능을 향상시키기 위해1 일정 
기간 통안 삭제되지 않습니다 . 이 음성 입력 데이터에는 오디오 파일j 사용자가 말한 
대화 기록j 관련 진단 데이터（하드웨어와 운영 체제 사양 및 성눙 통계）) 사용자가 
요청을 보냈을 때 기기 위치가 포함될 수 있습니다． 
유해1 콘텐츠 차단 설정에서 Sin 사용을 완전히 차단할 수도 있습니다． 
Sin를 사용하는 것온 Apple의 기타 제품 및 서비스에서 Sin 및 받아쓰기 기능을 제 
공하고 향상하기 위해I Apple과 그 자회사 및 에이전트가 사용자의 음성 입력 및 사 
용자 데이터의 전송j 수집 , 보존j 처리 및 사용하는 것에 대해 사용자가 통의하고 허 
용한 것입니다． 
Apple이 수집한 정보는 항상 Apple의 개인정보 취급방침에 따라 다루어지며 
www.ap미已CO!可kr乍巾acy 사이트에서 확인할 수 있습니다．

Perihal Siri dan Privasi (maeOS) 
Apabila anda menggunakan Siri, perkara yang anda sebut akan dirakam dan dihantar 
kepada Apple untuk memproses permintaan anda. Peranti anda juga akan menghantar 
maklumat lain kepada Apple, seperti nama dan nama panggilan anda; nama, nama 
panggilan dan perhubungan dengan anda (cthnya, "ayah saya") dalam kenalan buku 
alamat anda, nama lagu dalam koleksi anda, nama album foto anda dan nama aplikasi 
dipasang pada peranti anda (secara kolektif, "Data Pengguna" anda). Semua data ini 
digunakan untuk membantu Siri memahami anda dengan lebih baik dan mengenali 
perkara yang anda sebutkan. Data ini tidak dikaitkan dengan data lain yang mungkin 
dimiliki oleh Apple daripada penggunaan perkhidmatan Apple lain oleh anda. Apabila 
anda menggunakan Siri untuk mencari dokumen anda, permintaan Siri dihantar ke 
Apple, tetapi nama dan kandungan dokumen anda tidak dihantar ke Apple. Carian 
dijalankan secara setempat pada Mac. 
Jika anda telah mengaktifkan Perkhidmatan Lokasi, lokasi peranti anda pada masa 
anda membuat permintaan juga akan dihantar kepada Apple untuk membantu Siri 
meningkatkan ketepatan respons kepada permintaan anda. Anda boleh memilih untuk 
menyahaktifkan Perkhidmatan Lokasi untuk Siri. Untuk berbuat demikian, buka 
Keutamaan Sistem pada Mac anda, ketik Keselamatan & Privasi, ketik Perkhidmatan 
Lokasi, nyahpilih kotak semak untuk Siri. 
Anda boleh memilih untuk menyahaktifkan Siri pada bila-bila masa. Untuk 
menyahaktifkan Siri, buka Keutamaan Sistem pada Mac anda, ketik Siri dan nyahpilih 
kotak semak untuk Dayakan Siri. Jika anda menyahaktifkan ciri Siri dan juga 
Perencanaan, Apple akan memadamkan Data Pengguna anda serta data input suara 
terbaru anda. Data input suara lama yang telah dibatalkan perkaitan daripada anda 
mungkin disimpan untuk suatu tempoh masa bagi meningkatkan Siri, Perencanaan dan 
fungsi perencanaan dalam produk serta perkhidmatan Apple yang lain secara umum. 
Data input suara ini mungkin termasuk fail audio dan transkrip mengenai perkara yang 
anda sebut, data diagnostik yang berkaitan, seperti spesifikasi perkakasan dan sistem 
pengendalian dan statistik prestasi serta lokasi anggaran peranti anda pada masa 
permintaan dibuat. 
Anda juga boleh menyekat terus keupayaan untuk menggunakan Siri di bawah Seting 
Kawalan Ibu Bapa. 
Dengan menggunakan Siri, anda bersetuju dan mengizinkan penghantaran, 
pengumpulan, penyimpanan, pemprosesan dan penggunaan maklumat ini, termasuk 
input suara anda dan Data Pengguna oleh Apple dan subsidiari serta ejennya, untuk 
menyediakan dan meningkatkan fungsi Siri dan perencanaan dalam produk dan 
perkhidmatan Apple lain. 
EFTA00289214
--- PAGE 2 ---
Pada setiap masa, maklumat yang dikumpulkan oleh Apple akan dikendalikan 
berpandukan Dasar Privasi Apple, yang boleh ditemui di www.apple.com/my/privacy.

Info over Siri en privacy (macOS) 
Als je gebruikmaakt van Siri, wordt alles wat je zegt opgenomen en naar Apple gestuurd om je 
verzoeken te verwerken. Er wordt ook andere informatie van je apparaat naar Apple gestuurd, 
zoals je naam en bijnaam, de namen en bijnamen van je contactpersonen en je relatie tot hen 
(bijvoorbeeld "mijn vader"), titels van nummers in je verzameling, de namen van je fotoalbums 
en de namen van programma's die op je apparaat zijn geïnstalleerd (tezamen je 
"gebruikersgegevens"). Al deze gegevens worden gebruikt om Siri je beter te laten begrijpen en 
herkennen wat je zegt. Deze gegevens zijn niet gekoppeld aan andere gegevens die Apple van je 
kan hebben via je gebruik van andere Apple voorzieningen. Als je Siri gebruikt om naar je 
documenten te zoeken, wordt het verzoek aan Siri naar Apple verstuurd, maar de namen en de 
inhoud van je documenten niet. De zoekactie wordt lokaal uitgevoerd op de Mac. 
Als je 'Locatievoorzieningen' hebt ingeschakeld, wordt de locatie van je apparaat op het moment 
dat je een verzoek doet ook naar Apple gestuurd om Siri nauwkeuriger te laten reageren op je 
verzoeken. Desgewenst kun je 'Locatievoorzieningen' voor Siri uitschakelen. Open hiervoor 
Systeemvoorkeuren op je Mac, klik op 'Beveiliging en privacy', klik op 'Locatievoorzieningen' 
en schakel het selectievakje voor Siri uit. 
Je kunt Siri uitschakelen wanneer je wilt. Om Siri uit te schakelen, open je Systeemvoorkeuren 
op je Mac, selecteer je 'Siri' en schakel je het selectievakje 'Schakel Siri in' uit. Als je zowel Siri 
als de dicteerfunctie uitschakelt, verwijdert Apple je gebruikersgegevens evenals je recente 
steminvoergegevens. Oudere steminvoergegevens, die niet langer aan je identiteit zijn 
gekoppeld, worden mogelijk enige tijd bewaard om Siri, de dicteerfunctie en de 
dicteerfunctionaliteit in andere producten en voorzieningen van Apple te verbeteren. Deze 
steminvoergegevens kunnen bestaan uit audiobestanden en transcripties van wat je hebt gezegd, 
daaraan gerelateerde diagnostische gegevens, zoals specificaties van de hardware en het 
besturingssysteem en statistische gegevens over de werking, en de locatie bij benadering van je 
apparaat op het moment dat het verzoek werd gedaan. 
Je kunt het algehele gebruik van Siri beperken via 'Ouderlijk toezicht'. 
Door Siri te gebruiken stem je ermee in dat Apple en zijn dochterondernemingen en 
tussenpersonen de hierboven genoemde informatie, inclusief je steminvoer en 
gebruikersgegevens, mogen versturen, verzamelen, onderhouden, verwerken en gebruiken 
teneinde Siri, de dicteerfunctie en de dicteerfunctionaliteit in andere producten en voorzieningen 
van Apple te verbeteren. 
De door Apple verzamelde gegevens worden te allen tijde behandeld conform het privacybeleid 
van Apple, dat je kunt nalezen op http://www.apple.com/nl/privacy/.

Sobre Siri e Privacidade (macOS) 
Quando você usa a Siri, as coisas que você falar serão gravadas e enviadas à Apple para 
processar seus pedidos. Seu dispositivo também enviará outras informações à Apple, tais como o 
seu nome e apelido e os nomes, apelidos e relacionamentos (por exemplo, "meu pai") 
encontrados em seus contatos, além dos nomes de músicas da sua coleção, os nomes dos seus 
álbuns de fotos e os nomes dos aplicativos instalados no seu dispositivo (aqui chamados 
coletivamente de seus "Dados de Usuário"). Esses dados serão usados para ajudar a Siri a 
entender e reconhecer melhor o que você diz. Eles não serão vinculados a nenhum outro dado 
que a Apple possa ter coletado através do seu uso de outros serviços da Apple. Quando você usa 
a Siri para buscar documentos, o pedido feito à Siri é enviado à Apple, mas não os nomes e o 
conteúdo dos documentos. A busca é feita localmente no Mac. 
Se os Serviços de Localização estiverem ativados, a localização do dispositivo no momento em 
que você fizer um pedido também será enviada à Apple para ajudar a Siri a melhorar a precisão 
das suas respostas aos seus pedidos. Você pode desativar os Serviços de Localização para a Siri. 
Para isso, abra as Preferências do Sistema no Mac, dique em "Segurança e Privacidade", dique 
em "Serviços de Localização" e desmarque a caixa de verificação da Siri. 
Você pode optar por desativar a Siri a qualquer momento. Para desativar a Siri, abra as 
Preferências do Sistema no Mac, selecione Siri e desmarque a caixa de verificação Ativar Siri. 
Se você desativar os recursos Siri e Ditado, a Apple apagará seus Dados de Usuário, assim como 
seus dados de entrada de voz recentes. Os dados de voz mais antigos que foram desassociados a 
você podem ser retidos por um período de tempo, geralmente para aprimorar a Siri e a 
funcionalidade de ditado em outros produtos e serviços da Apple. Os dados de voz registrados 
podem incluir arquivos de áudio e transcrições do que você disse, dados de diagnóstico 
relacionados, tais como especificações de hardware e sistema operacional e estatísticas de 
desempenho, e a localização aproximada do dispositivo no momento em que o pedido foi feito. 
Você também pode restringir totalmente o uso da Siri no ajuste de Controles Parentais. 
Ao usar a Siri, você consente e concorda que a Apple, suas subsidiárias e agentes possam 
transmitir, coletar, manter, processar e usar essas informações, incluindo a sua voz e Dados de 
Usuário, para oferecer e melhorar a funcionalidade da Siri e do ditado em outros produtos e 
serviços da Apple. 
A todos os momentos, as informações coletadas pela Apple serão tratadas de acordo com a 
Política de Privacidade da Apple, que pode ser encontrada em www.apple.com/br/privacy.

Acerca de Siri e Privacidade (macOS) 
Quando usa a funcionalidade Siri, os pedidos falados são gravados e enviados å Apple para 
serem processados. Determinada informação contida no seu dispositivo, como o seu nome e 
alcunha, nomes, alcunhas e tipo de relação dos seus contactos (por exemplo, "pai"), nomes de 
músicas, os nomes dos seus álbuns de fotografias e os nomes das aplicações instaladas no seu 
dispositivo - coletivamente denominada "dados do utilizador" - será igualmente enviada à Apple. 
Toda esta informação é usada para ajudar Siri a melhor perceber e reconhecer o que lhe é dito. 
Esta informação não está relacionada com qualquer outro tipo de dados relativos à sua utilização 
de outros serviços da Apple que possam ter sido recolhidos. Quando usa Siri para procurar 
documentos, só é enviado à Apple o pedido efetuado a Siri, sem referência ao nome e conteúdo 
dos documentos. A pesquisa é realizada localmente, no Mac. 
Caso tenha os serviços de localização ativados, a localização do seu dispositivo no momento de 
envio do pedido será igualmente enviada å Apple para ajudar a funcionalidade Siri a melhorar a 
precisão das respostas. Pode optar por não permitir que Siri use os serviços de localização. Basta 
abrir as Preferências do Sistema no Mac, clicar em Segurança e Privacidade e, em Serviços de 
localização, desselecionar a opção Siri. 
Pode optar por desativar Siri em qualquer altura. Para tal, abra as Preferências do Sistema no seu 
Mac, selecione Siri e desselecione a opção Ativar Siri. Se desativar Siri e Ditado, a Apple 
apagará os seus dados de utilizador assim como os seus dados de voz enviados recentemente. 
Dados mais antigos que já não contenham informação pessoal serão retidos durante mais tempo e 
usados para ajudar a melhorar os serviços Siri, a funcionalidade de ditado e outros produtos e 
serviços da Apple. Estes podem incluir ficheiros de áudio e transcrições de pedidos efetuados, 
assim como todos os dados de diagnóstico relacionados, tais como especificações de hardware e 
de sistema operativo, estatísticas de desempenho e a localização aproximada do seu dispositivo 
na altura dos pedidos. 
Pode igualmente restringir a possibilidade de usar a funcionalidade Siri, nas preferências de 
Controlo Parental. 
Ao utilizar Siri, está a indicar que aceita e concorda que a Apple e respetivos agentes e 
subsidiárias possam transmitir, recolher, manter, processar e utilizar esta informação, incluindo 
os seus dados de voz e de utilizador para proporcionar e melhorar Siri e a funcionalidade de 
ditado noutros produtos e serviços. 
Toda e qualquer informação recolhida pela Apple será tratada de acordo e em conformidade com 
a Política de Privacidade da Apple, cujo texto pode ser consultado em 
www.apple.corn/pt/privacy.

Om Siri och integritetsskydd (macOS) 
När du använder Siri kommer det du säger och dikterar att spelas in och skickas till Apple för 
behandling. Enheten kommer även att skicka annan information till Apple, till exempel ditt namn 
och smeknamn; namn, smeknamn och relation till dig (t.ex. "pappa") från kontakterna i 
adressboken, låttitlar i din samling, namn på dina fotoalbum och namn på program som är 
installerade på din enhet (sammanfattningsvis dina "användardata"). Alla dessa data används i 
syfte att hjälpa Siri att bättre förstå dig och uppfatta vad du säger. De är inte länkade till andra 
data som Apple kan ha fått från din användning av andra Apple-tjänster. När du använder Siri till 
att söka efter dina dokument skickas Siri-förfrågningar till Apple, men dokumentens namn och 
innehåll skickas inte till Apple. Sökningarna utförs lokalt på datorn. 
Om du har Platstjänster påslaget skickas även enhetens plats till Apple när du gör en förfrågan i 
syfte att förbättra precisionen i Siris svar på dina förfrågningar. Du kan stänga av Platstjänster för 
Siri. Det gör du genom att öppna Systeminställningar på datorn, klicka på Säkerhet och 
integritet, klicka på Platstjänster och avmarkera kryssrutan för Siri. 
Du kan stänga av Siri när du vill. Du stänger av Siri genom att öppna Systeminställningar på 
datorn, klicka på Siri och avmarkera kryssrutan bredvid Aktivera Siri. Om du stänger av både 
Siri och dikteringsfunktionen kommer Apple att radera dina användardata och dina senaste 
röstinmatningar. Äldre röstinmatningar som inte längre är associerade med dig kan bibehållas en 
viss tid i syfte att generellt förbättra Siri, diktering och dikteringsfunktioner i andra produkter 
och tjänster från Apple. Dessa röstinmatningar kan omfatta ljudfiler och transkriberingar av det 
du sagt, relaterade diagnosdata (som specifikationer för maskinvara och operativsystem samt 
prestandastatistik) och den ungefärliga positionen för din enhet vid de tidpunkter som 
förfrågningar gjorts. 
Du kan även begränsa möjligheten att använda Siri i inställningspanelen Föräldrakontroll. 
Genom att använda Siri godkänner och samtycker du till att Apple och dess dotterbolag samt 
samarbetspartner överför, samlar in, sparar, behandlar och använder all nämnd information, 
inklusive dina röstinmatningar och användardata, i syfte att tillhandahålla och förbättra Siri och 
dikteringsfunktioner i andra produkter och tjänster från Apple. 
Information som samlas in av Apple kommer under alla förhållanden att behandlas i enlighet 
med Apples policy för integritetsskydd som finns på www.apple.com/se/privacy. 
EFTA00289221

Siri i prywatność (macOS) 
Gdy używasz Siri, Twoje słowa są nagrywane i wysyłane do Apple w celu przetworzenia. 
Razem z nimi urządzenie wysyła do Apple inne informacje, na przykład Twoje imię i nazwisko 
oraz pseudonim, nazwy Twoich kontaktów, ich pseudonimy oraz relacje z nimi (na przykład 
„tata"), nazwy utworów w posiadanych zbiorach, nazwy Twoich albumów zdjęć oraz nazwy 
programów zainstalowanych na Twoim urządzeniu (nazywane łącznie „Danymi Użytkownika"). 
Dane te pomagają Siri lepiej rozumieć, co mówisz. Nie są one wiązane z innymi danymi, które 
Apple otrzymuje z używanych przez Ciebie innych usług. Gdy używasz Siri do wyszukiwania 
dokumentów, do Apple wysyłane jest polecenie wydane Siri, ale nie są wysyłane nazwy oraz 
zawartość dokumentów. Wyszukiwanie wykonywane jest lokalnie na Macu. 
Jeśli masz włączone usługi lokalizacji, do Apple wysyłana jest także informacja, gdzie 
urządzenie znajdowało się w momencie wydania polecenia głosowego, aby pomóc Siri 
zwiększyć dokładność odpowiedzi. Usługi lokalizacji dla Siri możesz wyłączyć. W tym celu 
otwórz Preferencje systemowe na Macu, kliknij w Ochrona i prywatność, kliknij w Usługi 
lokalizacji i wyłącz zaznaczenie pola wyboru Siri. 
W dowolnym momencie możesz wyłączyć Siri. Aby wyłączyć Siri, otwórz Preferencje 
systemowe na Macu, wybierz Siri i wyłącz zaznaczenie pola wyboru Włącz Siri. Jeśli wylączysz 
zarówno Siri, jak i funkcję dyktowania, Apple usunie Twoje dane użytkownika oraz ostatnie 
Twoje polecenia i słowa. Starsze dane nie będą już powiązane z Tobą, ale mogą zostać 
zachowane przez pewien czas w celu poprawiania ogólnej sprawności Siri, dyktowania oraz 
innych produktów i usług Apple. Te polecenia głosowe i słowa mogą mieć formę plików audio 
i transkrypcji, powiązanych danych diagnostycznych, na przykład specyfikacji systemu 
operacyjnego i statystyk wydajności, a także przybliżone położenie urządzenia w momencie 
wydania polecenia. 
Możesz także calkowicie zablokować dostęp do Siri przy użyciu ustawień nadzoru 
rodzicielskiego. 
Korzystanie z Siri oznacza wyrażenie zgody na przesyłanie, gromadzenie, przechowywanie, 
przetwarzanie i używanie tych informacji (w tym danych głosowych i danych użytkownika) 
przez Apple, jego podmioty zależne i agentów na potrzeby działania i ulepszania Siri oraz 
funkcji dyktowania w innych produktach i usługach Apple. 
Informacje gromadzone przez Apple są zawsze traktowane zgodnie z zasadami prywatności 
Apple, dostępnymi na stronie www.apple.com/pl/privacy.

Om Sid og personvern (macOS) 
Når du bruker Siri, registreres det du sier, og henvendelsene sendes til Apple for behandling. 
Enheten sender også annen informasjon til Apple, for eksempel ditt navn og kallenavn, navn og 
kallenavn på kontakter i adresseboken samt relasjon (for eksempel «pappa»), sangtitler i 
samlingen din, navn på bildealbumer og navn på programmer som er installert på enheten 
(samlet betegnet som dine «brukerdata»). Disse dataene brukes for å hjelpe Siri med å forstå og 
gjenkjenne det du sier. De knyttes ikke til eventuelle andre data som Apple besitter fra din bruk 
av andre Apple-tjenester. Når du søker etter dokumenter med Siri, sendes kun Siri-forespørselen 
til Apple. Navn på og innhold i dokumenter sendes ikke til Apple. Dokumentsøket utføres lokalt 
på Macen. 
Hvis du har slått på Stedstjenester, sendes også posisjonen til enheten på det tidspunktet du 
sender en forespørsel, til Apple. Dette hjelper Sid med å gi bedre og mer nøyaktige svar. Du kan 
velge å slå av Stedstjenester for Siri. Det gjør du ved å åpne Systemvalg på Macen, klikke på 
Sikkerhet og personvern, klikke på Stedstjenester og fjerne markeringen for Sid. 
Du kan når som helst slå av Siri. Dette gjør du ved å åpne Systemvalg på Macen, velge Siri og 
fjerne markeringen i avkrysningsruten for Aktiver Siri. Hvis du slår av både Siri og 
dikteringsfunksjonen, vil Apple slette dine brukerdata, samt nylige taleinndata. Eldre taleinndata 
som ikke lenger kan spores tilbake til deg, kan beholdes i en begrenset periode for å forbedre Siri 
og diktering i andre produkter og tjenester fra Apple på generelt grunnlag. Disse taleinndataene 
kan omfatte lydfiler og avskrifter av det du har sagt, relaterte diagnostikkdata, som maskinvare-
og operativsystemspesifikasjoner og ytelsesstatistikk, og enhetens omtrentlige posisjon da 
forespørselen ble sendt. 
Du kan også sperre Siri helt under Foreldrekontroll-innstillingen. 
Ved å bruke Siri aksepterer du og samtykker du i at Apple og Apples datterselskaper og agenter 
overfører, innhenter, vedlikeholder, behandler og bruker all fømevnte informasjon, inkludert 
taleinndata og brukerdata, for å levere og forbedre Siri og dikteringsfunksjonaliteten i andre 
Apple-produkter og -tjenester. 
Informasjon som samles inn av Apple, vil alltid behandles i samsvar med Apples retningslinjer 
for personvern, som du kan lese på www.apple.com/no/privacy.

Siri ve Gizlilik Hakkında (macOS) 
Siri'yi kullanırken söylediğiniz şeyler kaydedilir ve isteklerinizin işlenmesi için Apple'a 
gönderilir. Aygıtınız; adınız ve takma adınız, kişilerinizde bulunan adlar, takma adlar, yakınlıklar 
(örneğin "babam"), koleksiyonunuzdaki parça adları, fotoğraf albümlerinizin adları ve 
aygıtınızda yüklü uygulama adlan (hep birlikte "Kullanıcı Verileriniz") gibi diğer bilgileri de 
Apple'a gönderir. Bu verilerin tümü, Siri'nin sizi daha iyi anlamasına ve söylediklerinizi 
tanımasına yardımcı olmak için kullanılır. Bu verilerle Apple'ın diğer Apple servislerini 
kullanmanız nedeniyle sahip olabileceği diğer veriler arasında bağlantı kurulmaz. Belgelerinizi 
aramak için Siri'yi kullandığınızda, Siri isteği Apple'a gönderilir ama belgelerinizin adları ve 
içeriği Apple'a gönderilmez. Arama Mac üzerinde yerel olarak gerçekleştirilir. 
Konum Servisleri özelliğiniz açıksa, Siri'nin isteklerinize vereceği yanıtın doğruluğuna 
artırmaya yardımcı olmak için aygıtınızın isteği yaptığınız andaki konumu da Apple'a gönderilir. 
Siri için Konum Servisleri'ni kapatmayı seçebilirsiniz. Bunu yapmak için, Mac'inizdeki Sistem 
Tercihleri'ni açın, Güvenlik ve Gizlilik'e tıklayın, Konum Servisleri'ne tıklayın, Siri onay 
kutusunun seçimini kaldınn. 
Siri'yi istediğiniz zaman kapatmayı seçebilirsiniz. Siri'yi kapatmak için Mac'inizdeki Sistem 
Tercihleri'ni açın, Siri'yi seçin ve Siri'yi Etkinleştir onay kutusunun seçimini kaldınn. Hem 
Siri'yi hem de Dikte özelliğini kapatırsanız Apple, Kullanıcı Verileri'nizle birlikte en son sesli 
giriş verilerinizi siler. Sizinle bağlantısı kalmamış daha eski sesli giriş verileri; Siri'yi, Dikte'yi 
ve diğer Apple ürünlerindeki ve servislerindeki dikte işlevselliğini genel olarak iyileştirmek 
amacıyla bir süre tutulabilir. Bu sesli giriş verileri arasında, söylediğiniz şeylerin ses dosyalan ve 
yazılı dökümleri, donanım ve işletim sistemi özellikleri ve performans istatistikleri ve aygıtınızın 
isteğin yapıldığı andaki yaklaşık konumu gibi ilgili tanı verilen olabilir. 
Ebeveyn Denetimleri ayarında, Siri kullanımını tamamen de sınırlayabilirsiniz. 
Siri'yi kullanarak, Apple ve Apple'ın bağlı kuruluşlarının ve temsilcilerinin Siri'yi ve diğer 
Apple ürünlerindeki ve servislerindeki dikte işlevselliğini sağlamak ve iyileştirmek için sesli 
girişleriniz ve Kullanıcı Verileriniz de dahil olmak üzere bu bilgileri iletmesini, toplamasını, 
bulundurmasını, işlemesini ve kullanmasını onaylayıp kabul etmektesiniz. 
Apple tarafından toplanan bilgiler her zaman www.apple.com/tr/privacy adresinde bulunan 
Apple'ın Gizlilik Politikası'na uygun bir şekilde işlenir.

O Sid a súkromí (macOS) 
Pri používaní Siri bude kW:di spracovaniu vašich žiadosti všetko, čo poviete, zaznamenané 
a odoslané do Apple. Vaše zariadenie odošle do Apple aj d'alšie informácie, ako napriklad vaše 
meno a prezývku, mená kontaktov v adresári, ich prezývky a vzťah s vami (napr. „mój otec"), 
názvy skladieb vo vašich zbierkach, názvy vašich albumov fotiek a názvy aplikácií 
nainštalovaných na vašom zariadení (súhmne označované ako „uživaterské dáta"). Všetky tieto 
dála sú použité na to, aby mohla služba Siri lepšie rozpoznávať, čo hovorite. Tieto dáta nebudú 
pnepojené so žiadnymi dalšími dátami, ktoré mohli byť zhromaidené spoločnosťou Apple pri 
používaní mých služieb. Ked' použijete Siri na prehradanie svojich dokumentov, bude do Apple 
odoslaná len táto žiadosť, názvy a obsah vašich dokumentov nebudå odoslané. Vyhradávanie 
pnebehne lokálne na vašom Macu. 
Ak máte zapnuté lokalizačné služby, bude kvedi presnejšej odpovedi Siri na vaše žiadosti 
odoslaná do Apple aj poloha vášho zariadenia v čase vytvorenia žiadosti. Lokalizačné služby pre 
Siri móžete kedykorvek vypnúť. Ak chcete vypnúť lokalizačné služby pre Siri, otvorte 
Systémové nastavenia na svojom Macu, kliknite na Bezpečnosť a såkromie, kliknite na 
Lokalizačné služby a zrušte zaškrtnutie možnosti Siri. 
Siri móžete kedykorvek vypnúť. Ak chcete vypnúť Siri, otvorte Systémové nastavenia na 
svojom Macu, vyberte Siri a zrušte zašlcrtnutie možnosti Povoliť Siri. Ak zároveň vypnete Siri aj 
Diktovanie, Apple vymaže všetky vaše uživaterské dáta a posledně hlasové dáta. Staršie hlasové 
dáta, ktoré boli upravené tak, že ich nemožno dať do súvisu s vami, však móžu byť dočasne 
uchované na účely všeobecného vylepšovania služieb Siri, Diktovanie a dalších funkcií 
diktovania v mých produktoch a službách spoločnosti Apple. Tieto hlasové dáta móžu zahfilať 
audiosåbory a prepisy toho, čo ste povedali, a s tým súvisiace diagnostické dáta, ako napriklad 
špecifikácie hardvéru a operačného systému, štatistiky výkonu a približnú polohu vášho 
zariadenia v čase odoslania žiadosti. 
Používanie služby Siri móžete úpine obmedziť v nastaveniach Rodičovskej ochrany. 
Používaním Siri sůhlasíte s tým, že spoločnosť Apple a jej dcérske spoločnosti a zástupcovia 
móžu za íračelom poskytovania a vylepšovania Siri a funkčnosti diktovania v d'alšich produktoch 
a službách Apple prenášať, zhromažd'ovať, spravovat', spracovávať a používať tieto informácie 
vrátane vášho hlasového vstupu a uživaterských dát. 
Všetky informácie zhromažd'ované spoločnosťou Apple budú spracované a uchované v sålade so 
zásadami ochrany osobných údajov Apple, ktoré nájdete na adrese www.apple.corniskiprivacy.

关于Sini 与隐私(macOS) 
当您使用Sin 时，您说的内容将被录音并发送给Apple，以处理您请求的操作°您的设备 
还将给Apple 发送其他信息，如您的名字和昵称：在您地址簿中找到的联系人名字、昵称 
、与您的关系（如“我的爸爸”〕：您个人收藏中的歌曲名称，相簿名称以及您设备上所安 
装应用的名称（以上统称“用户数据”）°这些数据均用来帮助Siii 更好地理解并识别您所 
说的话°与您使用Apple 其他服务时Apple 可能收集的其他数据没有关联°在使用Sini 
搜索您的文稿时，仅有Sin 的请求会发送给Apple，文稿的名称和内容不会发送给Apple 
°文稿搜索会在Mac 本地执行° 
如果已启用“定位服务”，那么您向Apple 发送请求时的设备位置也将被发送给Apple,以 
帮助Sin 提高响应请求的准确性°您可以选择关闭Sin 的定位服务°若要关闭，请前往 
Mac 并打开“系统偏好设置”，依次点按“安全性与隐私”、“定位服务”，取消选择Sin 的复 
选框° 
您可以随时选择关闭Sini
若要关闭Sin,请前往Mac 并打开“系统偏好设置”，选择 
"Sin ",然后取消选择“启用Sin"复选框°如果Sin 和“听写”功能均已关闭，Apple 将会删 
除您的“用户数据”以及您最近的语音输入数据°已与您没有关联的旧语音输入数据可能会 
保宙一段时间，用来对Sini “听写”及其他Apple 产品及服务的听写功能作一般性改进° 
此语音输入数据可能包括音频文件，您说话的誊本，诸如硬件、操作系统规格和性能统计 
数据之类的相关诊断数据，以及提出请求时设备的大致位置° 
您也可以在“家长控制”设置中限制使用Sini° 
使用Sin,您即接受并同意Apple 及其下属公司及代理机构传输、收集、维护、处理及使 
用前述之全部信息，包括您的语音输入及用户数据，以提供并改进Sin 及其他Apple 产 
品和服务的听写功能° 
Apple 收集的信息始终会遵照Apple 的“隐私政策”处理，其内容可参阅 
www．印ple.com1cn/pnvacy°

關於Sini 和隱私權(macOS) 
當您使用Sin 時，將會收錄您說話的內容，並傳送到Apple 來處理您的要求　您的裝置 
也會傳送其他資訊給Apple,例如您的姓名和暱稱悠通訊錄聯絡人的姓名、III檯稱和他們與 
您的關係（例如「我的父親」）、選集中的歌曲名稱、照片相簿的名稱、裝置中已安裝的App 
名稱（合稱您的「使用者資料」）　所有這些資料都是用來協助Siii 能更清楚地瞭解和辨 
識您所說的內容　不會連結到您使用其他Apple 服務時提供給Apple 的其他資料　當您 
使用Sin 來搜尋文件時，會傳送Sin 要求給Apple,但不會傳送文件的名稱和內容　搜 
尋是在Mac 本機上執行的　 
若您開啟了「定位服務」，當您提出要求時，裝置的所在位置也會傳送給Apple,以協助Siii 
改進回應您要求時的準確度　您可以選擇關閉Sii 的「定位服務」。若要將其關閉，誚打 
開Mac 上的「系統偏好設定」，按一下「安全性與隱私」，按一下「定位服務」，並取 
消勾選Sin
的註記框　 
您可以随時選擇關閉Sin 　若要關閉Sin,請打開Mac 上的「系統偏好設定」，選擇Siii 
，然後取消勾選「啟用Sin ]註記框　若您同時關閉Sin 和「聽寫」功能，Apple 將會剛 
除您的「使用者資料」以及您最近的語音翰入資料　已與您無關的先前語音翰入資料可能 
會保留一段時問，用來改進Siri％ 「雜寫」和其他Apple 產晶與服務中的璁寫功能　這些 
語音翰入資料可能包含您說話的音訊檔案和文字記錄，以及相關的診斷資料，例如硬體和 
作業系統規格與效能統計資料，和傳送要求時您裝置的大約位置等　 
您也可以在「分級保護控制」設定中一起限制使用Sin
功能　 
使用Sin,即表示同意並接受Apple 及其子公司和代理公司可以傳送、收集嵬維護、處理 
和使用此資訊，包含您的語音輸入和「使用者資料」，以便提供並改進其他Apple 產晶與 
服務中的Sin 和璐寫功能　 
在任何時間，Apple 都會依照[Apple 隱私權政策」的規定來處理收集的資訊．請參訪 
www．印ple.com/twlpnivacy 網站

Preamble 
The licenses for most software are designed to take away your freedom to share and change it. By contrast, the GNU 
General Public Licenses are intended to guarantee your freedom to share and change free software--to make sure the 
software is free for all its users. 
This license, the Lesser General Public License, applies to some specially designated software packages--typically 
libraries—of the Free Software Foundation and other authors who decide to use it. You can use it too, but we suggest 
you first think carefully about whether this license or the ordinary General Public License is the better strategy to 
use in any particular case, based on the explanations below. 
When we speak of free software, we are referring to freedom of use, not price. Our General Public Licenses are 
designed to make sure that you have the freedom to distribute copies of free software (and charge for this service if 
you wish); that you receive source code or can get it if you want it; that you can change the software and use pieces 
of it in new free programs; and that you are informed that you can do these things. 
To protect your rights, we need to make restrictions that forbid distributors to deny you these rights or to ask you to 
surrender these rights. These restrictions translate to certain responsibilities for you if you distribute copies of the 
library or if you modify it. 
For example, if you distribute copies of the library, whether gratis or for a fee, you must give the recipients all the 
rights that we gave you. You must make sure that they, too, receive or can get the source code. If you link other code 
with the library, you must provide complete object files to the recipients, so that they can relink them with the 
library after making changes to the library and recompiling it. And you must show them these terms so they know 
their rights. 
We protect your rights with a two-step method: (I) we copyright the library, and (2) we offer you this license, which 
gives you legal permission to copy, distribute and/or modify the library. 
To protect each distributor, we want to make it very clear that there is no warranty for the free library. Also, if the 
library is modified by someone else and passed on, the recipients should know that what they have is not the original 
version, so that the original author's reputation will not be affected by problems that might be introduced by others. 
Finally, software patents pose a constant threat to the existence of any free program. We wish to make sure that a 
company cannot effectively restrict the users of a free program by obtaining a restrictive license from a patent 
holder. Therefore, we insist that any patent license obtained for a version of the library must be consistent with the 
full freedom of use specified in this license. 
Most GNU software, including some libraries, is covered by the ordinary GNU General Public License. This 
license, the GNU Lesser General Public License, applies to certain designated libraries, and is quite different from 
the ordinary General Public License. We use this license for certain libraries in order to permit linking those libraries 
into non-free programs. 
When a program is linked with a library, whether statically or using a shared library, the combination of the two is 
legally speaking a combined work, a derivative of the original library. The ordinary General Public License 
therefore permits such linking only if the entire combination fits its criteria of freedom. The Lesser General Public 
License permits more lax criteria for linking other code with the library. 
We call this license the "Lesser" General Public License because it does Less to protect the user's freedom than the 
ordinary General Public License. It also provides other free software developers Less of an advantage over 
competing non-free programs. These disadvantages are the reason we use the ordinary General Public License for 
many libraries. However, the Lesser license provides advantages in certain special circumstances. 
For example, on rare occasions, there may be a special need to encourage the widest possible use of a certain library, 
so that it becomes a de-facto standard. To achieve this, non-free programs must be allowed to use the library. A 
more frequent case is that a free library does the same job as widely used non-free libraries. In this case, there is 
little to gain by limiting the free library to free software only, so we use the Lesser General Public License. 
In other cases, permission to use a particular library in non-free programs enables a greater number of people to use 
a large body of free software. For example, permission to use the GNU C Library in non-free programs enables 
many more people to use the whole GNU operating system, as well as its variant, the GNU/Linux operating system. 
Although the Lesser General Public License is Less protective of the users' freedom, it does ensure that the user of a 
program that is linked with the Library has the freedom and the wherewithal to run that program using a modified 
version of the Library.

Preamble 
The licenses for most software are designed to take away your freedom to share and change it. By contrast, the 
GNU General Public Licenses are intended to guarantee your freedom to share and change free software--to make 
sure the software is free for all its users. This license, the Library General Public License, applies to some specially 
designated Free Software Foundation software, and to any other libraries whose authors decide to use it. You can 
use it for your libraries, too. 
When we speak of free software, we are referring to freedom, not price. Our General Public Licenses are designed 
to make sure that you have the freedom to distribute copies of free software (and charge for this service if you wish), 
that you receive source code or can get it if you want it, that you can change the software or use pieces of it in new 
free programs; and that you know you can do these things. 
To protect your rights, we need to make restrictions that forbid anyone to deny you these rights or to ask you to 
surrender the rights. These restrictions translate to certain responsibilities for you if you distribute copies of the 
library, or if you modify it. 
For example, if you distribute copies of the library, whether gratis or for a fee, you must give the recipients all the 
rights that we gave you. You must make sure that they, too, receive or can get the source code. If you link a 
program with the library, you must provide complete object files to the recipients so that they can relink them with 
the library, after making changes to the library and recompiling it. And you must show them these terms so they 
know their rights. Our method of protecting your rights has two steps: (1) copyright the library, and (2) offer you 
this license which gives you legal permission to copy, distribute and/or modify the library. 
Also, for each distributor's protection, we want to make certain that everyone understands that there is no warranty 
for this free library. If the library is modified by someone else and passed on, we want its recipients to know that 
what they have is not the original version, so that any problems introduced by others will not reflect on the original 
authors' reputations. 
Finally, any free program is threatened constantly by software patents. We wish to avoid the danger that 
companies distributing free software will individually obtain patent licenses, thus in effect transforming the program 
into proprietary software. To prevent this, we have made it clear that any patent must be licensed for everyone's 
free use or not licensed at all. 
Most GNU software, including some libraries, is covered by the ordinary GNU General Public License, which was 
designed for utility programs. This license, the GNU Library General Public License, applies to certain designated 
libraries. This license is quite different from the ordinary one; be sure to read it in full, and don't assume that 
anything in it is the same as in the ordinary license. 
The reason we have a separate public license for some libraries is that they blur the distinction we usually make 
between modifying or adding to a program and simply using it. Linking a program with a library, without 
changing the library, is in some sense simply using the library, and is analogous to running a utility program or 
application program. However, in a textual and legal sense, the linked executable is a combined work, a derivative 
of the original library, and the ordinary General Public License treats it as such. 
Because of this blurred distinction, using the ordinary General Public License for libraries did not effectively 
promote software sharing, because most developers did not use the libraries. We concluded that weaker conditions 
might promote sharing better. 
However, unrestricted linking of non-free programs would deprive the users of those programs of all benefit from 
the free status of the libraries themselves. This Library General Public License is intended to permit developers of 
non-free programs to use free libraries, while preserving your freedom as a user of such programs to change the free 
libraries that are incorporated in them. (We have not seen how to achieve this as regards changes in header files, 
but we have achieved it as regards changes in the actual functions of the Library.) The hope is that this will lead to 
faster development of free libraries. 
The precise terms and conditions for copying, distribution and modification follow. Pay close attention to the 
difference between a work based on the library and a work that uses the library. The former contains code derived

curve25519-donna: Curve25519 elliptic curve, public key function. 
http://code.google.com/p/curve25519-donna/ 
Adam Langley <agl@imperialviolet.org>
Derived from public domain C code by Daniel J. Bernstein <:11bacr.yo.to>. More information 
about curve25519 can be found here http://cr.yp.to/ecdh.html. djb's sample implementation of 
curve25519 is written in a special assembly language called qhasm and uses the floating point 
registers. This is, almost, a clean room reimplementation from the curve25519 paper. It uses 
many of the tricks described therein. Only the crecip function is taken from the sample 
implementation.

and some code used as part of the build process might fall under other licenses. The details here 
are unclear. We do not worry about the licensing of the documentation and build code so much 
because none of these things are part of the core deliverable SQLite library. 
All of the deliverable code in SQLite has been written from scratch. No code has been taken 
from other projects or from the open intemet. Every line of code can be traced back to its 
original author, and all of those authors have public domain dedications on file. So the SQLite 
code base is clean and is uncontaminated with f you feel like you really have to purchase a 
license for SQLite, Hwaci, the company that employs the architect and principal developers of 
SQLite, will sell you one. 
Obtaining An Explicit License To Use SQLite 
Even though SQLite is in the public domain and does not require a license, some users want to 
obtain a license anyway. Some reasons for obtaining a license include: 
• You are using SQLite in a jurisdiction that does not recognize the public domain. 
• You are using SQLite in a jurisdiction that does not recognize the right of an author to 
dedicate their work to the public domain. 
• You want to hold a tangible legal document as evidence that you have the legal right to use 
and distribute SQLite. 
• Your legal department tells you that you have to purchase a license. 
If you feel like you really have to purchase a license for SQLite, Hwaci, the company that 
employs the architect and principal developers of SQLite, will sell you one. 
Contributed Code 
In order to keep SQLite completely free and unencumbered by copyright, all new contributors to 
the SQLite code base are asked to dedicate their contributions to the public domain. If you want 
to send a patch or enhancement for possible inclusion in the SQLite source tree, please 
accompany the patch with the following statement: 
The author or authors of this code dedicate any and all copyright interest in this code to the 
public domain. We make this dedication for the benefit of the public at large and to the detriment 
of our heirs and successors. We intend this dedication to be an overt act of relinquishment in 
perpetuity of all present and future rights to this code under copyright law. 
We are not able to accept patches or changes to SQLite that are not accompanied by a statement 
such as the above. In addition, if you make changes or enhancements as an employee, then a 
simple statement such as the above is insufficient. You must also send by surface mail a 
copyright release signed by a company officer. A signed original of the copyright release should 
be mailed to: Hwaci, 6200 Maple Cove Lane, Charlotte, NC 28269,USA. A template copyright 
release is available in PDF or HTML. You can use this release to make future changes.

BSD Protection License, February 2002 
Preamble 
The Berkeley Software Distribution ("BSD") license has proven very effective over the years at allowing for a wide 
spread of work throughout both commercial and non-commercial products. For programmers whose primary 
intention is to improve the general quality of available software, it is arguable that there is no better license than the 
BSD license, as it permits improvements to be used wherever they will help, without idealogical or metallic 
constraint. 
This is of particular value to those who produce reference implementations of proposed standards: The case of 
TCP/IP clearly illustrates that freely and universally available implementations leads the rapid acceptance of 
standards -- often even being used instead of a de jure standard (eg, OSI network models). 
With the rapid proliferation of software licensed under the GNU General Public License, however, the continued 
success of this role is called into question. Given that the inclusion of a few lines of "GPL-tainted" work into a 
larger body of work will result in restricted distribution -- and given that further work will likely build upon the 
"tainted" portions, making them difficult to remove at a future date -- there are inevitable circumstances where 
EFTA00289386
--- PAGE 145 ---
authors would, in order to protect their goal of providing for the widespread usage of their work, wish to guard 
against such "GPL-taint". 
In addition, one can imagine that companies which operate by producing and selling (possibly closed-source) code 
would wish to protect themselves against the rise of a GPL-licensed competitor. While under existing licenses this 
would mean not releasing their code under any form of open license, if a license existed under which they could 
incorporate any improvements back into their own (commercial) products then they might be far more willing to 
provide for non-closed distribution. 
For the above reasons, we put forth this "BSD Protection License": A license designed to retain the freedom granted 
by the BSD license to use licensed works in a wide variety of settings, both non-commercial and commercial, while 
protecting the work from having future contributors restrict that freedom. 
The precise terms and conditions for copying, distribution, and modification follow.

For those of you that choose to use the GNU General Public License, my interpretation of the 
GNU General Public License is that no Perl script falls under the terms of the GPL unless you 
explicitly put said script under the terms of the GPL yourself. Furthermore, any object code 
linked with perl does not automatically fall under the terms of the GPL, provided such object 
code only adds definitions of subroutines and variables, and does not otherwise impair the 
resulting interpreter from executing any standard Perl script. 
I consider linking in C 
subroutines in this manner to be the moral equivalent of defining subroutines in the Perl 
language itself. You may sell such an object file as proprietary provided that you provide or 
offer to provide the Perl source, as specified by the GNU General Public License. (This is 
merely an alternate way of specifying input to the program.) You may also sell a binary 
produced by the dumping of a running Perl script that belongs to you, provided that you provide 
or offer to provide the Perl source as specified by the GPL. (The fact that a Perl interpreter and 
your code are in the same binary file is, in this case, a form of mere aggregation.) This is my 
interpretation of the GPL. If you still have concerns or difficulties understanding my intent, 
feel free to contact me. Of course, the Artistic License spells all this out for your protection, so 
you may prefer to use that.

Research Proposal 
A. Title 
How could nerve stimulation/acupuncture treat inflammatory disorders including 
sepsis, arthritis, brain degeneration disorders? 
B. Background and Significance 
Many human diseases are caused by excessive inflammation. Take severe sepsis as 
an example, which developed in patients with infection, trauma, and cancer (Angu 
and van der Poll, 2013). A hallmark of sepsis is excessive release of inflammatory 
cytokines that could cause organ dysfunctions and death, whose treatment remains a 
major medical challenge. In addition, inflammation has been linked with cancer 
development and side effects of cancer treadtment, such as chemotherapy-induced 
peripheral neuropathy. Worldwide, one-third of people who develop sepsis die. In the 
United States alone, over 250,000 patients died annually from sepsis, and the 
survived half million suffer various organ damage. The total hospital cost for all 
patients with severe sepsis was estimated to be $24.3 billion in 2007. Another form of 
inflammatory disorders is severe arthritis, with annual cost estimated to be close to 
$100 billion in USA. In recent years, it has also been increasingly recognized that 
brain degeneration disorders are partly caused by neurogenic inflammation, with 
activated microglia (related to the peripheral macrophages) contributing to abnormal 
neuronal activity and cell death. Thus, developing new effective treatment for severe 
inflammation is urgent and the underlying business potential is enormous. 
While no effective drugs are available to treat sepsis and other severe inflammatory 
disorders, new hope does emerge in the past decade and half. That is, excessive 
inflammation can be managed by direct vagal nerve stimulation or indirect acupoint 
stimulation. The vagal nerve exits from the hindbrain and carries brain signals to 
modulate most organ activity in our body. In papers published in Science and Nature, 
Dr. Kevin Tracey and his colleagues showed that vagal nerve stimulation can release 
neurotransmitters to suppress the release of inflammatory cytokines from 
macrophages and other immune cells (Borovikova et al., 2000; Chavan and Tracey, 
2014). In a study published in Nature Medicine in 2014 (Torres-Rosas et al., 2014), 
Ulloa and his colleagues show that stimulation of the ST36 acupoint in the hindlimb 
can suppress sepsis symptoms and promote animal survival, through a mechanism 
that depends on the activation of the vagal nerve. Collectively, these 
anti-inflammation effects via direct or indirect activation of the vagal nerve can 
dramatically promote animal survival in experimental sepsis models, thereby offering 
a novel strategy to treat severe inflammatory disorders (Chavan and Tracey, 2014). 
Notably, it has also been suggested that vagal nerve stimulation can dampen the 
release of inflammatory cytokines from the activated osteoclast associated with 
EFTA00289473
--- PAGE 2 ---
osteoarthritis and the activated microglia in the brain, raising the hope that 
osteoarthritis and brain degeneration disorders might also be managed by the vagal 
nerve stimulation or by acupoint stimulation. Thus, a further study to improve this 
therapeutic strategy is of enormous business potential. 
C. Our general conceptual framework and the ways to test this 
It should be first pointed out that the vagal nerve stimulation discussed above, which 
eventually leads to activation of parasympathetic nerves and immune suppression, 
only represents one branch of nerve stimulations in modulating body physiology. The 
other major branch is the activation of the sympathetic nerves that act to antagonize 
the activity of parasympathetic nerves, such as enhancing immune activity, rather 
than immune suppression, thereby providing Yin-Yang balance. 
We have a general theoretical framework on what kinds of acupoints whose activation 
could preferentially activate one of two opposing branches of the nervous system and 
regulate opposing physiology, such as immune suppression versus immune 
enhancement. We will use the genetic tools created in the Ma and Chiu labs to 
validate our hypothesis. Based on our hypothesis and subsequent validation, we will 
determine the best acupoints used for treating various diseases, such as 
inflammatory disorders discussed above. Within the selected acupoints, we will also 
optimize the parameters of acupuncture or electric stimulation (such as the intensity, 
duration, frequency, and depth of tissues) to achieve the best effects. Clinically, Dr. 
Lu's oncology acupuncture team at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute has conducted a 
randomized clinical trial to test the effectiveness of chemotherapy-induced peripheral 
neuropathy; an inflammation related never damage caused by chemotherapy drugs, 
in breast cancer patients. The preliminary results of the study so far are extremely 
encouraging. Therefore, we not only study acupuncture mechanisms in animals but 
also test it in real patients for real clinical conditions. Our unique strength and capacity 
from bench-to-bedside hold great promise for developing new therapeutic options. We 
are confident our research will not only make a contribution to understanding the 
overall conceptual framework about how acupuncture works, but also come back to 
improve acupuncture practice for disease treatment. 
D. The collaborative team 
The above conceptual framework was built upon extensive discussion with several 
top TCM clinical doctors and basic acupuncture scientists in China (and also in USA), 
as well as the basic science and clinical investigators in USA who have deep 
understanding of the neural pathways and mind-body interactions in regulating 
human/animal physiology. The doctors with deep understanding of TCM theories and 
extensive clinical experience are critical for knowing what acupoints and acupuncture 
EFTA00289474
--- PAGE 3 ---
handling methods (i.e., different depth of needling) to treat different diseases. Such 
information is crucial for basic scientists to form the conceptual framework or theories 
to explain how acupuncture works. Finally, it needs basic scientists to create new 
modem tools to test the hypotheses. The findings from basic scientists will be fed 
back to clinical doctors. Ultimately, acupuncture clinical trials in real patients should 
be carried out to confirm these findings. Thus, a deep interaction between TCM 
doctors/scientists in China and basic scientists and clinicians in USA is the key for 
making a fundamental breakthough. 
The proposed team at Harvard: 
Dr. Qiufu Ma, Professor of Neurobiology at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and 
Department of Neurobiology of HMS. He has been mapping neural circuits 
responding to various somatic sensory stimuli, and his lab's creation of a large cohort 
of mouse lines in which individual sensory pathways have been removed will offer an 
unique opportunity to study the neural basis of acupuncture. 
Dr. Isaac Chiu, an excellent young Assistant Professor at HMS who has been trained 
in both immunology and pain-related neurobiology, will be crucial for studying 
nerve-immune interactions, a key foundation for understanding how 
TCM/acupuncture works. 
Dr. Weidong Lu, the Oncology Acupuncture team leader at Dana-Farber Cancer 
Institute, who also is the Chair of the Committee of Acupuncture in Massacussetts, a 
professor at The New England School of Acupuncture and Instructor in Medicine of 
HMS, will be critical in linking basic science and clinical research at HMS 
Dr. Shing tung Yau of Harvard, in collaboration with Dr. Tse L Lai of Stanford 
University, will help to set up data analysis program in Tsinghua university to help the 
analysis the data that are related to traditional Chinese medicine. 
The above HMS scientists/doctors have building active collaborations with the 
following top TCM/acupuncture doctors/scientists in China: 
1) Dr. Bin Zhu and Dr. Xianghong Jing, the former President and the current vice 
President of Beijing Institute of Acupuncture and Moxibustion. 
2) Drs Gengcheng Wu and Yanqing Wang, the former and current Chairs of 
Department of Integrative Medicine at Fudan Universities. 
3) Dr Baixiao Zhao, President of Beijing Tui-Na Institute, and personal TCM 
doctor for Chinese top leaders 
4) Dr. Hongsheng Lin, Department Chair of Integrative Oncology, Beijing Guang 
An Men Hospital, Chinese Academy of Tradiational Chinese Medical Sciences 
EFTA00289475
--- PAGE 4 ---
5) Dr. Zhiqiang Meng, Department Chair of Integrative Oncology, Cancer 
Hospital at Fudan University 
E, Potential requested funding 
1) Support four postdoctoral fellows or students to work in four different 
HMS/Stanford labs (Drs. Ma, Chiu, Lu, Yau/Lai). A three-year support will 
need around $400,000. 
2) Equipment for Lu's lab for acupuncture-related human physiology studies 
($100,000) (This part has no indirect overhead cost) 
3) Equipment for Ma's lab: In vivo electrophysiological recording system to 
determine what acupuncture activates ($150,000), and the ultrasound guided 
in vivo injection systems to activate specific neural pathways to mimic 
acupuncture effects ($250,000). (This part has no indirect overhead cost) 
4) Equipment for Chiu's lab: in vivo physiology measurement in small animals 
(such as heart rate variability and gastrointenstinal movements reflected by 
activation of different amount of sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves: 
$100,000) (This part has no indirect overhead cost) 
5) Animal housing for Ma plus Chiu Labs: $20,000/year/lab. Total: 
$120,000/3years (This part has no indirect overhead cost) 
6) Pilot human clinical trials for Lu lab: Total: $120,000/3yrs 
7) General supply cost for three labs (Ma, Lu and Chiu): $14,500/year/lab. Total: 
$130,000/3yrs 
8) Overhead for items 1, 6, 7 (20%): $130,000 for all three years 
In total: $1,500,000 for three-year support. 
Optional: if the funding is large enough, a two-photo imaging system will be extremely 
useful for acupuncture studies ($500,000).

SCHEDULE OF EXCEPTIONS 
December 26, 2013 
In connection with that certain Note Purchase Agreement, dated as of December 26, 2013 
(as amended, the "Agreement"), by and among AdFin Solutions, Inc. (the "Company") and the 
Investor named therein, the Company hereby delivers this Schedule of Exceptions to the Company's 
representations and warranties given in the Agreement. This Schedule of Exceptions and the 
information and disclosures contained herein are intended only to qualify and limit the 
representations, warranties and covenants of the Company contained in the Agreement, and shall not 
be deemed to expand in any way the scope or effect of any of such representations, warranties or 
covenants. The section numbers in this Schedule of Exceptions correspond to the section numbers 
in the Agreement; provided, however, that any information disclosed herein under any section 
number shall be deemed to be disclosed and incorporated in any other section of the Agreement 
where such disclosure would be appropriate and reasonably apparent. Where the terms of a 
contract, agreement or other disclosure item have been summarized or described in this Schedule of 
Exceptions, such summary or description does not purport to be a complete statement of the 
material terms of such contract, agreement or other disclosure item and such summary or description 
is qualified in its entirety by such contract, agreement or other disclosure item. A disclosure or 
statement in this Schedule of Exceptions shall not be construed as indicating that such matter is 
material, has or could have a material adverse effect on the Company or is necessarily required to be 
disclosed by the Company. No disclosure in this Schedule of Exceptions relating to any possible or 
alleged breach or alleged violation of any agreement, law or regulation shall be construed as an 
admission or indication that any such alleged breach or alleged violation exists or has actually 
occurred or that a basis for any defense to such allegation or claim does not exist or that any basis 
for any counter-claim or cross-complaint against the claimant does not exist. Capitalized terms used 
but not defined herein shall have the same meanings given them in the Agreement.

NOTE PURCHASE AGREEMENT 
This Note Purchase Agreement, dated as of December 26, 2013 (this "Agreements), is entered into 
by and among AdFin Solutions, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), and the entity listed on the 
schedule of investors attached hereto as Schedule I (the "Investor"), as such Schedule I may be amended in 
accordance with Section 9 hereof. 
RECITALS 
A. 
On the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein, the Investor is willing to purchase 
from the Company, and the Company is willing to sell to such Investor, an unsecured convertible promissory 
note in the principal amount of $2,000,000. 
B. 
Capitalized terms not otherwise defined herein shall have the meaning set forth in the form of 
Note (as defined below) attached hereto as Exhibit A. 
AGREEMENT 
NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, and the representations, warranties, and 
conditions set forth below, the parties hereto, intending to be legally bound, hereby agree as follows: 
I. The Note 
(a) Issuance of Note. Subject to all of the terms and conditions hereof, the Company agrees 
to issue and sell to the Investor a convertible promissory note in the form of Exhibit A hereto (the "Note") 
in the principal amount of $2,000,000. 
(b) Delivery. The sale and purchase of the Note shall take place at a closing (the -Closing") 
to be held at such place and time as the Company and the Investor may determine (the "Closing Date") by 
check or wire of immediately available funds from the Investor to the Company in accordance with the 
attached Company Wire Instructions (provided below). At the Closing, the Company will deliver to the 
Investor the Note, against receipt by the Company of $2,000,000 (the "Purchase Price"). 
(c) Use of Proceeds. The proceeds of the sale and issuance of the Notes shall be used for 
general corporate purposes and working capital, subject to the terms and conditions of the Note. 
2. Representations and Warranties of the Company. Except as set forth in the Disclosure 
Schedule delivered to Investor in connection herewith, the Company represents and warrants to the 
Investor that:

qualified, licensed to do business and in good standing as a foreign corporation in each jurisdiction where the 
failure to be so qualified or licensed has had or could reasonably be expected to have a material adverse 
effect on the business, property, financial condition or results of operations of the Company (a "Material 
Adverse Effect"). 
(b) Authority. The Company has all requisite corporate power and authority to execute, 
deliver and consummate the transactions provided under this Agreement and the Note (collectively, the 
"Transaction Documents"), and the execution, delivery and consummation of the transactions

Preferred Stock pursuant to this Section 4 shall be made pro rata among the holders of the Series 
A Preferred Stock in proportion to the number of shares of such Preferred Stock then held by 
each holder. 
(b) 
Procedure. At least fifteen (15) but no more than thirty (30) days prior to 
the Redemption Date, written notice shall be mailed, first class postage prepaid, to each holder of 
record (at the close of business on the business day next preceding the day on which notice is 
given) of the Preferred Stock to be redeemed, at the address last shown on the records of the 
Corporation for such holder, notifying the holder of the redemption to be effected, specifying the 
number of shares to be redeemed from such holder, the Redemption Date, the applicable 
Redemption Price and the place at which payment may be obtained and calling upon such holder 
to surrender to the Corporation, in the manner and at the place designated, such holder's 
certificate or certificates representing the shares to be redeemed (the "Redemption Notice"). 
Except as provided in Section 4(c), on or after the Redemption Date, each holder of shares of 
Preferred Stock to be redeemed shall surrender to the Corporation the certificate or certificates 
representing such shares, in the manner and at the place designated in the Redemption Notice, 
and thereupon the applicable Redemption Price of such shares shall be payable to the order of the 
person whose name appears on such certificate or certificates as the owner thereof and each 
surrendered certificate shall be cancelled. In the event less than all the shares represented by any 
such certificate are redeemed, a new certificate shall be issued representing the unredeemed 
shares.

5. Voting Rights.

class vote.

Election of Directors. At each election of directors of the Corporation, (i) 
the holders of Series A Preferred Stock, voting as a separate class, shall be entitled to elect one 
(1) director, (ii) the holders of Common Stock, voting as a separate class, shall be entitled to 
elect three (3) directors and (iii) the holders of Preferred Stock and Common Stock, voting 
together as a single class on an as-convened basis, shall be entitled to elect the remaining 
directors of the Corporation. Any director elected as provided in the preceding sentence may be 
removed with or without cause by, and only by, the affirmative vote of the holders of the shares 
of the class or series of stock entitled to elect such director or directors, given either at a special 
meeting of such stockholders duly called for that purpose or pursuant to a written consent of 
stockholders.

written ballot, unless the Bylaws of the Corporation so provide. Except as otherwise provided in

also have power to make, adopt, amend, alter or repeal the Bylaws of the Corporation.

shall not adversely affect any right or protection of a director of the Corporation existing at the 
time of, or increase the liability of any director of the Corporation with respect to any acts or
